title: Losing George Lewis and the key musicians who carry a band
summary: Jaffe says George's death affects him personally and that a dozen key musicians like Percy and Jim can make a weak band interesting.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
